title: Comp AI sets eyes on a continuously agentic future for security and compliance
summary: Comp AI, a cybersecurity and compliance startup, raised $34 million in Series A funding led by Roo Capital and Grand Ventures. The round reflects growing investor interest in AI-powered solutions for automated security and compliance workflows.
content: Comp AI, a cybersecurity and compliance startup, announced a $34 million Series A round led by Roo Capital and Grand Ventures.

zh.title: Comp AI着眼于安全和合规的持续智能代理未来
zh.summary: 网络安全和合规初创公司Comp AI获得了由Roo Capital和Grand Ventures领导的3400万美元A轮融资。这一轮融资反映了投资者对AI驱动的自动化安全和合规工作流程解决方案的日益增长的兴趣。

title: Iceland-based Treble raises $18 million for its voice simulation platform
summary: Iceland-based Treble secured $18 million in funding for its voice simulation platform used by AI developers, wearable manufacturers, and robotics companies. The platform enables these sectors to build and test voice AI applications more effectively.
content: Treble's voice simulation platform is used by voice AI model developers, AI wearable, and robotics companies

zh.title: 冰岛公司Treble为其语音模拟平台融资1800万美元
zh.summary: 冰岛公司Treble为其语音模拟平台获得了1800万美元融资,该平台被AI开发者、可穿戴设备制造商和机器人公司使用。该平台使这些行业能够更有效地构建和测试语音AI应用。

title: Your startup’s next teammate might be an AI agent: Gusto, Insight Partners, and Leland explain what that changes at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
summary: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 will host a session exploring how early-stage companies are integrating AI agents into their teams while maintaining speed, accountability, and company culture. The panel includes Gusto, Insight Partners, and Leland discussing practical approaches for founders adding AI teammates.
content: This session will explore how early-stage companies are building teams where humans and AI agents work alongside each other — and how founders can do that without sacrificing speed, accountability, or culture. Learn more at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026. Register before September 25 to save up to $200.

zh.title: 你的创业公司的下一个队友可能是一个AI助手：Gusto、Insight Partners和Leland在TechCrunch Disrupt 2026上解释将改变的内容
zh.summary: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026将举办一场会议，探讨早期创业公司如何在保持速度、问责制和公司文化的同时将AI助手集成到其团队中。小组成员包括Gusto、Insight Partners和Leland，讨论创始人添加AI队友的实际方法。

title: The streamers are fighting over Halloween
summary: Streaming platforms including Netflix, Amazon, Peacock, and AMC are launching major horror and horror-adjacent series in October, with premieres at the Toronto International Film Festival signaling the month's growing importance in streaming competition. Notable releases include an adaptation of Stephen King's Carrie on Prime Video.
content:
The Toronto International Film Festival is a place to go to see the future of film, but this year it also provided a glimpse at what is coming very soon in the realm of streaming. Four different streamers - Peacock, Netflix, Amazon, and AMC - all premiered early looks at upcoming horror-adjacent series that are dropping very soon. And by doing it at TIFF, they showed just how important the month of October has become in the realm of streaming.

zh.title: 流媒体平台在争夺万圣节
zh.summary: 包括Netflix、Amazon、Peacock和AMC在内的流媒体平台正在10月推出重大恐怖和恐怖相关系列，多伦多国际电影节的首映标志着该月在流媒体竞争中日益重要。值得注意的发布包括Stephen King的《Carrie》在Prime Video上的改编作品。

title: Snap tries to make the case again for its $2,200 smart glasses
summary: Snap continues its marketing push for Specs, its $2,200 augmented reality glasses that debuted earlier in 2026, as the company seeks to build a compelling case for consumer adoption of the premium wearable device.
content: Since Specs' debut earlier this year, Snap has clearly been looking for an opportunity to explain why the smart glasses deserve to exist.

zh.title: Snap再次为其2200美元的智能眼镜辩护
zh.summary: Snap继续推进其Specs产品的营销，该产品是其2200美元的增强现实眼镜，于2026年初首次亮相。该公司正在寻求为消费者采用这款高端可穿戴设备做出有说服力的案例。
